2125368643865514056.en_summary: Trump on Jensen Huang pardon: always an option but probably not necessary. He wants Huang to tell the truth and not take the Fifth. On a government $NVDA stake, he thought about it and said it's probably not too late. Source: NY Post.
2125368643865514056.zh_summary: 特朗普談及黃仁勳赦免：一直是選項但可能不必要。他希望黃仁勳說出真相，而非援引第五修正案。關於政府持有$NVDA股份，他曾考慮過且表示可能為時未晚。來源：紐約郵報。

2125367783521177817.en_summary: Moved $COGT to the left side of the portfolio today as a commercial company. Criteria to stay there now more intense as only the best of the best stay in top 5.
2125367783521177817.zh_summary: 今天將$COGT移至投資組合左側，作為一家商業公司。現在留下的標準更加嚴格，只有最優秀的才能留在前五名。

2125367723395842429.en_summary: Nine of eleven S&P 500 sectors finished higher, but $SPX lower as technology dropped more than 3% with $NVDA, $MU and other $SMH stocks giving back Monday's gains. Healthcare surged 3%, consumer staples gained 1.7%, with $GILD, $ABBV, $BGEN showing relative strength. Discusses rotation from growth, key S&P levels at 6900 and 7350, potential breakout in $BRO and bullish divergences in $MU and $GOOGL.
2125367723395842429.zh_summary: 標普500十一個板塊中有九個收高，但$SPX下跌，因科技股下跌超過3%，$NVDA、$MU及其他$SMH股票回吐周一漲幅。醫療保健飆升3%，消費必需品上漲1.7%，$GILD、$ABBV、$BGEN展現相對強勢。討論從成長股的輪動、標普關鍵水平6900及7350、$BRO潛在突破以及$MU和$GOOGL的看漲背離。

2125367359984566370.en_summary: Gameplan still to fade the biotech bubble down to minimum weights (top 4 core positions). Can move to $SGOV until better value appears, then focus on great value in fintech, tech, Asia and South America. Sell to eager buyers and buy from eager sellers.
2125367359984566370.zh_summary: 計劃仍是淡化生物科技泡沫至最低權重（前4核心倉位）。可轉至$SGOV直至出現更好價值，然後專注金融科技、科技、亞洲及南美的優質價值。賣給急於買入者，向急於賣出者買入。

2125367302723887440.en_summary: Trump says it is not too late for the U.S. to acquire a stake in $NVDA, the New York Post reported. Trump says he has not yet raised the possibility of a U.S. stake in Nvidia.
2125367302723887440.zh_summary: 特朗普稱美國收購$NVDA股份為時未晚，紐約郵報報導。特朗普表示尚未提出美國持有Nvidia股份的可能性。
